title: AXCore
description: A simple plugin for your needs.
body:
# AXCore
AXCore is the future of core plugins. AXCore is currently small, but will be big soon! 

### Features:
- Chat formatting
- Join / Leave messages
- Customizable messages
### Commands:
- `/fly` - Enable / Disable flying.
- `/brodcast` - Brodcast a message to the server.
### Permissions:
- `axcore.fly` - Permission for the fly command.
- `axcore.brodcast` - Permission for the brodcast command.
- `axcore.chatformat` - Eanbles color in chat for the user.
